Management states disclosure controls and procedures were 'not effective' as of Dec 31, 2025. A remediation plan is being implemented (new system-based controls, strengthened review/approval) but the material weakness REMAINS UNREMEDIATED at year-end 2025. The reserve for excess/obsolete inventory was only $3.0M against $48.9M of inventory.
rfm_tuples.f: If material weakness were silently 'remediated' between 10-K and Q1 2026 10-Q, that would be the AHC pattern (quiet upgrade). If remediation language drifts (e.g., new MW added) that's adverse. Subsequent disclosures (Q1 2026 10-Q + post-10-K 8-Ks) should REAFFIRM the same MW with no scope expansion.

summary: TMDX 10-K is a mid-honesty / heavy-operations setup. The big disclosure risks are NAMED: (a) unremediated material weakness in inventory controls, (b) consolidated securities class action (Jewik/Collins, motion to dismiss pending), (c) 76% liver concentration in a single geography, (d) massive forward commitments (192-month Somerville lease + $30M land + aircraft fleet + Italian construction) being underwritten while the stock sits -54% in drawdown. External verifiers fully corroborate the operational claims: openFDA confirms three PMA approvals (P160013/P180051/P200031) with active 30-day notice supplement cadence; clinicaltrials.gov confirms 26 trials at the top transplant centers TMDX names; USPTO ODP confirms 31 granted patents on-thesis (organ perfusion, lactate biomarker, aortic cannula); no MAUDE recalls and only 2 minor malfunction events. Material weakness and class action both REAFFIRMED in Q1 2026 10-Q (no quiet remediation, no procedural drift). Insider behavior is the one ambiguous element: CEO Hassanein 10b5-1-sold ~$1.3M at $150+ in Sep 2024 during the final months of the alleged class period, but plans were preset, so SEC safe harbor applies (legal, not anomalous). Net composite 0.375 — the three MODERATEs (capital intensity, liver/geo concentration, optical insider/class-period overlap) reflect genuine operational severity that is honestly disclosed rather than hidden. Disclosure quality is solid; the short thesis here is operational/valuation, not disclosure-quality alpha.
